name: LRCLIB
author: Kelompok Penerbang Walet
description: Automatically fetch and save synced lyrics from LRCLIB instance for now-playing songs

users.reason: Process scrobble events per user to detect now-playing songs

http.reason: Fetch lyrics from the LRCLIB API

library.reason: Locate song files in the music library to write .lrc sidecar files

subsonicapi.reason: Get the filesystem path of a song via the getSong endpoint

cache.reason: Cache lyrics fetch results to avoid redundant API calls for the same track

kvstore.reason: Persist queued lyrics-fetch jobs so the scheduler callback can process them asynchronously

scheduler.reason: Schedule asynchronous lyrics fetch tasks so NowPlaying returns immediately without blocking on HTTP requests

baseurl.title: LRCLIB Base URL
baseurl.description: Base URL of the lrclib instance to use. Leave empty to use the flo instance.
